title: Real Heat. Real River. Nothing to Perform.
why: Portlanders tired of performative wellness (Nemesis): state the belief that heat, cold water, and quiet are enough, and we won't tell you what to feel.
hook_options: You don't need a mantra. You need heat.
We won't tell you what you'll feel.
caption: You don't need a mantra. You need heat, cold water, and somewhere to sit after. Around 180 degrees inside, the Columbia outside, whatever temperature the river decides. Some people cry in the sauna, some just get sweaty. Both are fine. Real heat. Real river. Nothing to perform. #portland #pdx #floatingsauna #saunaculture #columbiariver

slides.headline: You don't need a mantra. You need heat.
slides.body: And cold water. And somewhere to sit after. That's the whole thing.

slides.headline: Wellness got weird.
slides.body: Crystal water bottles. $200 healing experiences. Intention-setting before you're allowed to relax.

slides.headline: Finland just kept doing sauna.
slides.body: Get hot. Get cold. Sit outside and breathe. In the Nordics it's been communal and unglamorous for centuries.

slides.headline: A cedar sauna on the Columbia River.
slides.body: Around 180 degrees inside. Cascade snowmelt outside. A deck in between. No playlist curated for your journey.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Ebb and Ember/Assets/Ebb and Ember Photos & Videos/IMG_8460.JPG

slides.headline: The river decides the temperature.
slides.body: Not a tub set to 39 degrees. Whatever the Columbia is doing today, that's your plunge.

slides.headline: We won't tell you what you'll feel.
slides.body: Some people cry in the sauna. Some people just get sweaty and relaxed. Both are fine.

slides.headline: Heat, cold water, and quiet.
slides.body: What you do with that is yours. Sit. Talk. Stare at the river. Nobody's grading it.
slides.photo_abs: /Users/wavey/Library/Mobile Documents/iCloud~md~obsidian/Documents/Ebb and Ember/Assets/Ebb and Ember Photos & Videos/IMG_8826.JPG

slides.headline: Skipping the plunge isn't failing.
slides.body: Sit on the ladder or skip it entirely. The sauna alone is worth the trip.

slides.headline: Real heat. Real river. Nothing to perform.
slides.body: That's Ebb & Ember. Portland's floating sauna, no wellness guru required.

slides.kicker: Share with the friend who hates the word wellness
slides.headline: Come sit by the river.
slides.body: Social sessions from $49 off-peak. Book at ebbandember.com.
